title: 秋華賞の後に・勝利に酔って

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka taps into her true strength, pushing through the intense Shuka Sho to defeat Daiwa Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her loss, Daiwa Scarlet promises to hone her skills and come back to defeat Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before walking off, she tells Vodka she will be running in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup before the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling that she's not progressing as well as Daiwa Scarlet, who always has a clear goal, Vodka decides to run in the Arima Kinen as well.
